card.name: Space before a number of hours
card.fires_on: The space or opening parenthesis just before a number that will be followed by "hours", such as 12, 16, 18 or 24. It appears in dosing intervals, infusion windows and storage times.

modes.label: Hours in a table cell
modes.description: The slot before an interval number in a dosing table whose column is labeled hours.

card.writes: It boosts number words like sixteen, twelve and fourteen and suppresses the word hour itself, so it favors the number before it.
card.plain: It fires just before a number of hours, like 12 or 24, in a dosing interval or storage time.
